title: Asahina Mafuyu — Like A Heart In My Hands〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: Like A Heart In My Hands（4★）

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Now I just need to leave the house...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'll get there too early if I leave now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Why is that...?
I'd be leaving more or less at my usual time.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I could have breakfast... But I'm not all that hungry.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Right. I always had breakfast with Mom before I left until now. That must be why I have some extra time on my hands...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I wanted to get an early start today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Would you like some breakfast?
That should help you become fully awake.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Good idea...
Ms. Mochizuki has been saying that I need to eat more properly...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, I'll have a quick bite...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, I'll start getting everything ready.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see... First, I need to put out some plates...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, I need to take the food Ms. Mochizuki made out of the fridge...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: These look like the boiled greens... This looks like that fish and vegetable stew...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll grab some plates for them, heat up the fish and...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: O-Okay. Then, I'm sure you'll want some jam to go with that. Where did I put them...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
The jam should be on that shelf.
The butter's towards the top of the refrigerator, so I'll grab that as well.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why don't you go wash your face in the meantime?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, okay. In that case, I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, see you in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
All done...
Oh, so are you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I-I'm really sorry... I didn't mean for you to get everything ready for us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: All I had to do was heat up the food.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, right... You have to get to school.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, this is nice since I don't usually eat many when left to my own devices.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think Mochizuki made this because she wants you to eat healthier, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I noticed that most of the dishes she made has vegetables.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm guessing that's because you rely only on instant noodles.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, you may be right...
I should thank her the next chance I get.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
What time do you think you'll be returning from school today?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have to go to club today, so I may not be back for a little while...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You have club today?
Then, I'll make it so you can take a bath right when you get back.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll be working as usual, so please let me know if you need anything.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I've felt it before. But where?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Things aren't as lively as they were at that time...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You didn't have much, Mafuyu? Are you sure that's going to be enough?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, since I wasn't actually all that hungry.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I'm glad we got to have breakfast together.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, that sounds nice.
Oh, let me help you this time.
